CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.
   C. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)

   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Parable of the Lost Sheep and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
